about.title: FRUITFUL, NOT FORMAL.
about.intro: Fruity is a bright, clean merch brand built around a simple identity: black, warm white and fruit-yellow, with enough personality to avoid looking like another generic storefront.
about.body: We want the site and the products to feel like the same thing. Clear product information, strong photography, fruit-led colour and a visual identity that stays recognisable without getting in the way of buying something.
about.secondary: The About content is shared with the home page. Edit it once in admin and the home story updates with it.
